t: AI Creative Expression: Style Explorer — Simple
name: AI Creative Expression: Style Explorer — Simple
title: AI Creative Expression: Style Explorer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An explorer that maps the style space around an artist's work: it embeds the portfolio, samples neighboring styles, and renders variations the artist can accept, reject, or steer. Exploration is directed by taste, not by slot machine.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Explored-space diversity across 512 variants = 9.0 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI-Powered Universal Creative Expression (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Latent-space exploration tools are standard in generative art workflows.
signature_version: Signature version: the creativity Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (novelty vs coherence) scored per exploration from artist feedback, with the 'universal expression' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: embed the artist's own work first, sample the neighborhood, and let rejects reshape the map.
math_note: Explored-space diversity across 512 variants: 9.0 bits [verified]; Gallery archive: 500 variants x 4 MB = 2000 MB: 0.0020 TB [verified]

safety: Ownership safety: the artist owns all outputs and all model adaptations — the tool claims nothing.
how_it_works: Portfolio embeddings define the neighborhood; the sampler proposes variations; the artist's accepts/rejects reshape the map. The demo recomputes the diversity bits of the explored space and the archive cost of the variant gallery.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: AI Creative Expression: Composition Assistant — Simple
name: AI Creative Expression: Composition Assistant — Simple
title: AI Creative Expression: Composition Assistant — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An assistant that helps finish works, not start them: given the artist's draft, it proposes continuations in the draft's own idiom, each labeled as machine-proposed. The artist accepts, edits, or discards — authorship stays human.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Proposal entropy at p=0.35 = 0.9341 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI-Powered Universal Creative Expression (Chapter)
real_world_basis: AI-assisted composition with human authorship is standard in music and writing tools.
signature_version: Signature version: the creativity Totality assessor — artist-created vs machine-proposed as a computed ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: learn the artist's idiom first, label every proposal, and keep the human as the only author.
math_note: Proposal entropy at p=0.35: 0.9341 bits [verified]; Practice step F(10) in the drill ladder: 55 step [verified]

math_check.label: Practice step F(10) in the drill ladder

safety: Authorship safety: machine proposals are never presented as the artist's unaided work — labeling is mandatory.
how_it_works: Drafts feed the continuation model; proposals render with machine-proposed labels; the artist's edits train the personal idiom. The demo recomputes the entropy of the proposal distribution and the Fibonacci-structured practice schedule.

t: AI Creative Expression: Provenance Tracker — Simple
name: AI Creative Expression: Provenance Tracker — Simple
title: AI Creative Expression: Provenance Tracker — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A tracker that records how a work was made: which parts are human, which are machine-proposed, which sources trained the tools. Provenance travels with the work so credit and consent stay computable forever.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Provenance-log collision odds, 2M works in 64 bits = 1.084e-07 probability. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI-Powered Universal Creative Expression (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Content provenance (C2PA-style) is the industry's answer to synthetic-media accountability.
signature_version: Signature version: the creativity First/Last assessor — first sketch (first) and final work (last) anchored with full provenance, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: log creation events as they happen, bind provenance to the file, and make it verifiable by anyone.
math_note: Provenance-log collision odds, 2M works in 64 bits: 1.084e-07 probability [verified]; Work-ID check digit (demo): 9 digit [verified]

math_check.label: Provenance-log collision odds, 2M works in 64 bits

safety: Consent safety: training sources are listed; any source that withdraws consent is removed from future training.
how_it_works: Creation events log to a provenance record; the record binds to the work file. The demo recomputes the hash-collision odds for the provenance log and the ISBN-style check digit for work IDs.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
